notes.title: 2025 Update 1
notes.content:
[h3]New aviation[/h3]
M-3999 Merveille Drone Deployer: Merveille is a special aviation using "Dagger" to track and shoot directly at enemies.
[h3]New stats:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Damage over Time: some weapon will cause damage over time on hitting targets. 
[*] Active Radar Range: this stat affects projectiles using active radar homing 
[*] Firing speed: different from attack speed, firing speed affects how fast the aviation or host can shoot a cluster of bullets/missiles.
[*] Magazine: this stat determines how many rounds some weapons, e.g. turrets, can emit.
[/list]
[h3]New weapons and enhancements:[/h3]
Adding several new weapons and enhancements.
